name: context-canvas-surface-reading
description: Reads a Context Canvas page or route family as a visitor surface and primary design input. Applies before assessment, planning, or material changes to a Canvas page, embedded instrument, or family relationship.

contract.what: A source-grounded model of one page or route family.
when: Assessment, planning, or material visitor-surface change begins.
boundaries: Page meaning remains rooted in authored source, evidence boundaries, and human authority. Visual variation remains available within the wider grammar.
contract.result: Route standing, visitor ability, evidence boundary, runtime owners, visual fingerprint, and affected family.

receivingUse.job: Assessment, planning, or material visitor-surface change begins.
receivingUse.materialResult: Route standing, visitor ability, evidence boundary, runtime owners, visual fingerprint, and affected family.
receivingUse.completion: The receiving collaborator can locate the semantic source, work within its boundaries, and recognize the material result.

standing.evidenceMaturity: Repository-maintained portable contract with source-specific, revisable material-use evidence.
standing.wakeTrigger: Material use, human correction, receiving-artifact behavior, or independent evidence changes this route.

transferBoundary: This projection carries repository-local instruction yield. Current intent, repository evidence, and granted tool authority govern each activation.
